summary: Senior Backend Engineer with 8+ years of experience in logistics and payments platforms. Cut nightly report runtime from 6 hours to 40 minutes at Harbor Logistics and launched a refunds service at Brightwave Payments. Led 3 engineers through a zero-downtime JDK 17 upgrade and raised unit coverage on a checkout API.

bullets.text: Reduced failed deliveries from 120 a week to 4 by moving retries to Amazon SQS dead-letter queues and paging the owning team when any queue aged past 5 minutes.
Cut nightly shipment-report runtime from 6 hours to 40 minutes by rewriting the AWS Glue job as partitioned Parquet reads and adding retry-safe checkpoints.
Ended 14 manual deploys a month by moving the routing service to Amazon ECS on AWS Fargate with Terraform modules and a blue-green pipeline that rolls back on failure.
Shipped idempotent retries for the payment-status API, cutting duplicate charges from 35 a month to zero by adding request keys in Amazon DynamoDB with conditional writes.
Led 3 engineers through a JDK 17 upgrade of 9 services with zero downtime by sequencing canary releases and adding contract tests for every public endpoint.
Launched a refunds service that lowered support tickets 30% by checking each request against the ledger before payout and returning clear error codes to the mobile app.
Raised unit coverage on the checkout API from 41% to 83% by adding contract tests and a nightly integration suite that ran against a copy of production data.
Migrated 1.2M stored card tokens to a new vault in 3 weeks with no failed charges by running dual writes and comparing a checksum of each record nightly.
Automated payroll file imports for 6 partner banks, saving 15 hours a week, by writing a Python parser and Amazon S3 event triggers that validated each upload on arrival.

bullets.text: Published an open-source CLI that converts OpenAPI specs to Postman collections, reaching 220 GitHub stars by documenting 12 examples and answering issues within 2 days.
